title: Bulk passivation and suppressing non-radiative recombination loss in a 3D all-inorganic CsPbIBr2 perovskite solar cell via a 2D layered perovskite framework
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01437E, Paper
Tapas Das, Faisal Farooq, Parul Garg, Sakal Singla, Asim Guchhait, Ashok Bera
Bulk passivation in the CsPbIBr2 absorber layer with controlled (PEA)2PbI4 doping reduces the nonradiative recombination loss resulting in enhanced performance and stability in solution-processed CsPbIBr2-based perovskite solar cells.
